units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 19:10">Targ. Ps. XIX, 10</cite> <he>צְדִיקוּ</he> Ms. (ed. <he>זכיאו</he>).

senses.gloss: to justify, do justice to. Ib. LXXXII, 3.—א׳ דינא to acknowledge the justice of divine judgment.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 22b:6">Taan. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>דקא מַצְדִּיק דינא אנפשיה וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מצדיק עליה וכ׳</he>) that he acknowledged the justice of God’s decree over him, saying (<cite ref="Lamentations 1:18">Lam. I, 18</cite>) &c.
